topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Learning Objectives
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the final lecture of the course and outlines the learning objectives regarding cancer treatment approaches.

topics.label: Conventional Modalities: Surgery, Radiotherapy, and Cytotoxic Chemotherapy
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the principles, systemic toxicities, and resistance mechanisms associated with traditional cancer treatments.

topics.label: Exploiting Intrinsic Cancer Cell Vulnerabilities
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore therapeutic approaches that exploit cancer-specific defects in hormone signaling, cell cycle checkpoints, and DNA damage repair pathways.

topics.label: Targeted Kinase Inhibitors and Mechanisms of Resistance
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics address the inhibition of hyperactivated oncogenic kinases and the molecular pathways driving clinical drug resistance and addiction.

topics.label: Therapeutic Antibodies and Antibody-Drug Conjugates
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the mechanisms and applications of engineered monoclonal antibodies and antibody-linked cytotoxics.

topics.label: Cancer Immunotherapy and T-Cell Activation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics discuss tumor immune surveillance and strategies to engage host immunity through checkpoint inhibition, bispecific antibodies, and CAR T cells.

topics.label: Challenges, Future Perspectives, and Treatment Outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics assess ongoing obstacles in oncology alongside historical survival trends, emerging clinical paradigms, and ethical dilemmas.
